title: Revolving playground / open portals and padded fans
question: Read the support, wait for the crossing, choose a route. The same supported bay can carry a shuttle, linked leaves, a scaling bridge or a revolving obstacle. Read the axis and time your passage.

stages.title: 01 / Rise into the scaffold
stages.hint: Board TC from the low pad. Ride up and step forward onto the first dock.

stages.title: 02 / Fan X / face the propeller
stages.hint: A padded propeller turns beside the crossing. Keep to the open side or time your passage; contact can push you onto the electrical ground.

stages.title: 03 / Fan Y / revolving fins
stages.hint: Padded fins revolve beside the walkway. Stay on the open side, or feel their sideways push. The ground below is electrical.

stages.title: 04 / Fan Z / sideways wheel
stages.hint: A padded wheel turns along one edge of the path. Its solid fins push; the electrical danger is on the ground below.

stages.title: 05 / Sweep / jump the bar
stages.hint: One low electrical bar sweeps across the bridge. Jump as it approaches, then regain a stable landing.

stages.title: 06 / Disc / ride the turntable
stages.hint: A broad ivory disc rotates under your feet. Compensate for sideways motion as you cross to the far landing; its surface is safe to touch.

stages.title: 07 / Gates / two offset windows
stages.hint: Two electrified windows turn a quarter-cycle apart. Find an opening, pause between them, then pass the second.
